snippet.title: Valiants: Arena Beta Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Register and play now at:  https://playvaliants.com

Valiants: Arena is a turn-based combat game set in a dynamic 2.5D environment where you lead a team of creatures called Valiants in fast-paced, intense strategic battles. The game combines adventure, collection, and a touch of nostalgia, letting you command a team of Valiants alongside a customizable Tamer who can directly influence the fight.
